title: Astra Microwave Products Ltd (ASTRAMICRO) — Institutional Investment Dossier
archetype: Tactical Defense RF & Radar Sub-System Specialist
primer: Astra Microwave (NSE: ASTRAMICRO) holds a ₹4,708 Cr defence RF/radar backlog and a fast-growing ARC JV (₹334 Cr H1 FY27 sales). Yet H1 FY27 operating cash flow fell to -₹147.85 Cr, lifting debt from ₹288 Cr to ₹487 Cr. Meanwhile, ₹130.50 Cr in warrant proceeds remains unpaid before Dec 29, 2026, HAL's Uttam deal is 47% of standalone backlog, and WTD Atim Kabra trimmed his stake. At ₹1,600.70 (2026-11-25 live TV close; ₹1,623.30 on 2026-11-23 NSE ledger; 70.61x P/E) in Stage 4, new capital is REJECTED (TIER_0). On our 180 Zerodha shares (6.85% weight), we execute EXIT_ON_BOUNCE: sell 90 shares now, and exit the rest on any bounce into ₹1,621–₹1,670 or below our ₹1,539.80 stop.
holding_rationale: Zerodha holds 180 shares at ₹1,684.72 average cost (₹3,03,250.32 total). On the 2026-11-23 NSE ledger (₹1,623.30), value is ₹2,92,194.00 (-3.65%, 6.85% weight). At the 2026-11-25 live TV close (₹1,600.70), value is ₹2,88,126.00 (-4.99%). The tape broke into Stage 4 below its 50D (₹1,621.36) and 30W (₹1,607.16) averages. H1 FY27 CFO fell to -₹147.85 Cr, and expected value sits at ₹1,390 (-13.2%). Execute EXIT_ON_BOUNCE in two legs: sell 90 shares now to halve risk, and exit the rest on any bounce into ₹1,621–₹1,670 or below our locked ₹1,539.80 hard stop.
